notes.title: Winter Update
notes.notes:
From Summer of 2018 to December 2020 - 100$ was the price of entry.

An audacious act. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29934088/54a25edda5083065aa9566e0d490aa534565d575.png

Summer of 2019: An unexplained spike of interest from Eastern Europe.

Добро пожаловать на борт

~

Since 2012, I've been recreating the places I've lived. In the previous version you were able to see 3 of these spaces from a stationary position. With this update you are now able to freely traverse through 5 places.

notes.title: August Update
notes.notes:
The doors to this rocketship have closed.

You're all aboard, you take the form of a seahorse. It's fitting since Synthetic Dreams is a gaze-based experience (no arms required)

Our destination: Into the Void

notes.title: April Update
notes.notes:
From November 2016 Monthly Update: "... If VR is "somewhere you go" - then perhaps it would be helpful to think of yourself as selling tickets. Welcome to my Museum."

I think it's time to put INTRO (INTRO/CITY/PIXEL) into a box.

I think it's time to lay the foundations for a Museum.

I know it's time to find a better way to live.

Etymology: 

"from the Ancient Greek Μουσεῖον (Mouseion), which denotes a place or temple dedicated to the Muses (the patron divinities in Greek mythology of the arts)"

"The traditional names and specialties of the nine Muses, daughters of Zeus and Mnemosyne, are: Calliope (epic poetry), Clio (history), Erato (love poetry, lyric art), Euterpe (music, especially flute), Melpomene (tragedy), Polymnia (hymns), Terpsichore (dance), Thalia (comedy), Urania (astronomy)"

notes.title: March Update
notes.notes:
The Vive Pro is said to have a 33ft x 33ft (10m x 10m) tracking area. (When using 4 updated Lighthouses)

Combine this with a laptop in a backpack and I think you have a recipe for some amazing large-scale experiences.

I'm also curious how the SantaCruz will handle large, open, empty and bright environments.

~

It's Spring time in the SouthEast. The leafless trees (Analogous to Prison Bars this year) will transform into Massive Green Bushes.

Arguably the best time to be born, or perhaps re-born.

~ 

I imagine a future future version of ancestrydotcom, where we search cached versions of the internet to find postings from our forerunners.

notes.title: February Update
notes.notes:
A fresh build! Packaged with Unreal Engine 4.19 Preview 5 (!)

I've been shipping builds in development mode - this gives a bit of extra freedom to the console jockeys out there.

In October I mentioned a space to view those little colored dots we call pixels. It's in, but you'll need to travel there yourself.

Just hit the tilde key (~) and type "open hue" then use the keyboard to swap colors.

1 Red
2 Green
3 Blue
4 Yellow (R+G)
5 Cyan (G+B)
6 Magenta (R+B)
7 White
8 Gray
9 Black
0 Hueshift

notes.title: January Update
notes.notes:
Apartment life. The creaking of footsteps above me. Dog barks below me. Air Conditioners outside my bedroom window.

40 hour work week. Get home with a mental haze and vegetate.

I think the key to breaking this cycle will be to give myself an hour or two in the mornings. But then there's the matter of leaving that warm and cozy bed...

To those who purchased SD on the winter sale - you are 1 of 30. I like to imagine you all sitting together in a section of my spaceship.

My goal for next month is to release an update that brings SD up to engine version 4.19. (Pixel Density Standardization a driving factor)

If all goes well there will be a bit of new content too. Wish me luck in that battle against cozy bed bliss...

notes.title: December Update
notes.notes:
I released Synthetic Dreams on itch.io 2 years ago, then on Steam 4 months ago.

Releasing it at a "Normal" price seemed too much like inviting the internet over to my house. I want my patrons to feel invested. I want to create a connection.

For the Winter Sale - I am discounting it to the "Commodity price" - The price I would have released it at if maximizing profit was my goal.

This 'sale' is for the One-hundred and Sixty-three people with Synthetic Dreams on their Wishlist.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29934088/554ac84a4252eebf36827660286f4901469e8824.jpg

Thank you for your interest!

If you have any problems or suggestions, feel free to contact me directly.

Welcome aboard.

notes.title: November Update
notes.notes:
Back home. My computer and HMD have been in storage for over a month now. 

I'm in my old room, spent 13 years between these walls.

While I was away my father rearranged the furniture. The new layout generates a constant sense of strangeness.

Luckily, a new chapter is about to begin. A new job in a new city. I've built my career using the tools this company creates.

I sometimes think of SD as a time capsule for my memories. I've got some videos I'd like to add. Currently experimenting with media playback.

notes.title: October Update
notes.notes:
I'm having trouble finding a tone for these updates. I've been writing monthly updates on itch.io for 1.5 years, most of those read like a journal entry.

Lets just try to find our flow state. Where words come unmediated by conceptions of what a "Steam Update" should be. ;-)

I'm currently in limbo right now. Writing this from a basement living room. One path leads to Bellevue, the other leads East. There's a third path somewhere out there too...

In our HMDs each pixel is composed of 3 sub-pixels, Red Green Blue. When viewing different colors, you see different patterns in the pixels. I've created an environment for enjoyment and exploration of this phenomena.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29934088/b5caf34f81e0aa3a8b5727597b272546afec2d91.gif

When I attended SVVR, I got body-scanned by Artec3d. 5$ to download the .obj (Free to view on web)

Meet my flesh avatar - Monochrome GIF to shield you guys from the Uncanny Valley ;-)

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29934088/83903c4787b4f5876d1e3ed4d1d41cc1714364bf.gif

I'm unsure how I'll incorporate this into SD. My entire ABOUT section is due for a redesign...

notes.title: September Update
notes.notes:
First Steam update!

Now all of the INTRO experiences are grouped closer together.
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29934088/f0fd45fa319cc58344010904392e958e5dab6e3e.png

Also, I've added blockouts of my Irvine and Duvall rooms. (Accessable through Anaheim Hills by looking at bedroom door, or out to the patio door) I'm not sure I'll be adding any more detail to these. They mostly serve as a way for me to remember the size and shape of places I've occupied.
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29934088/c1a6ec9f180fd1d793c9fc6f6456363d4746800c.png

Hands-Free Quit/Return Functionality - Just look above you to initiate a return to the hub, or to quit if you're already in the hub. (This functionality unlocks after you've completed INTRO)
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29934088/a9ab0eacd5182a36c290e88b72fcfa812a06bfdb.gif

Random feature: Press CTRL + L at any time to show a Location Debug Widget!
